description: Creates a push-notification channel for changes to the user's calendar list. Notifications signal changes rather than providing full change details, and delivery is not completely reliable.

address.description: The HTTPS URL where notifications are delivered for this channel. Must have a valid SSL certificate.
address.human_parameter_description: The URL where notifications should be sent. Must be a publicly accessible HTTPS endpoint that you control.
address.title: Address

expiration.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds indicating when the API should stop sending notifications.
expiration.human_parameter_description: Optional expiration time as Unix timestamp in milliseconds. If not provided, the channel will expire after the default TTL period.
expiration.title: Expiration

id.description: A UUID or similar unique string that identifies this channel. Maximum 64 characters.
id.human_parameter_description: A unique identifier for this watch channel. Use a UUID or any unique string (max 64 characters) that you can track or use to stop the channel later.
id.title: Id

params.description: Additional parameters controlling delivery channel behavior.
params.human_parameter_description: Optional settings that control how the channel behaves, such as how long it should stay active (TTL).

ttl.description: Time-to-live in seconds for the notification channel. Default is 604800 seconds (7 days).
ttl.title: Ttl

params.title: CalendarListWatchRequestParams

token.description: An arbitrary string delivered to the target address with each notification. Maximum 256 characters. Used for channel verification and message routing.
token.human_parameter_description: Optional secret string that will be included with each notification, allowing your endpoint to verify the source.
token.title: Token

type.description: The type of delivery mechanism used for this channel. Must be "web_hook" or "webhook".
type.human_parameter_description: How notifications will be delivered. Use 'web_hook' to receive HTTP callbacks at the address you provide.
type.title: Type

name: calendar_list_watch

display_url.description: Notification channels have no web UI representation.
display_url.title: Display Url

expiration.description: Date and time of notification channel expiration, expressed as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds represented as a string.
expiration.title: Expiration

id.description: A unique string that identifies this channel. Matches the ID provided in the request.
id.title: Id

kind.description: Identifies this as a notification channel resource. Always "api#channel".
kind.title: Kind

resourceId.description: An opaque ID that identifies the resource being watched on this channel. Stable across different API versions.
resourceId.title: Resource Id

resourceUri.description: The canonical URI of the watched resource in the context of the current API version.
resourceUri.title: Resource Uri

token.description: The arbitrary verification token from the request, if provided.
token.title: Token
